visible.message: With `streamlit run --server.runOnSave true tmp.py`, saving a small change reruns my script several times (my print runs repeatedly). If I instead enable "Always rerun" in the web interface, it reruns once. It started with streamlit 1.47 or later and works as expected below 1.47. Python 3.10.18, Ubuntu 24.04.
